title: Laurie Wright and a misdated paper
summary: A London collector shows him a paper dating his record work later than he remembers.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's what I said. When I organized my band was '37.
That's what I'm saying, we never did get that--
When I got to London, Laurie Wright--I stayed out at his house for three nights. He said I want to show you something, here's the thing from the New York Age--
Then he showed me another list where I had made recordings for Louie way after that. I said how could that happen.
I don't know how in the world that ever got into that paper. That was a very small paper anyway.
